name: Hello Good-bye! ~Otoko Tomodachi Onna Tomodachi~
original_name: Hello Good-bye! ～男ともだち女ともだち～
source:
Main character is a college student who has a lover. They finally decide to live together for a month. But one day protagonist goes to a drinking party where he meets his former girlfriend. Suddenly his college female friends start to show signs of attention. There are also encounters with new girls. So what does "real love" mean?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名已有戀人的大學生。兩人終於決定同居一個月。然而某天，主角參加酒會時遇見了前女友，大學裡的女性朋友也也突然向他示好。此外，他還會邂逅新的女孩。那麼，何謂「真愛」？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
